profile.headline: Software Engineer | Python | Ruby on Rails
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
💫 Technologies: Ruby on Rails, Python, Javascript (ES6), SQL, HTML, and CSS. 

💫 Github: https://github.com/estef0214

positions.title: Production Assistant
positions.description:
• Directed the migration of orders and inventory to Sage 200 software, establishing an order pipeline spanning from development to payment. Implemented a central integrated system for the business, resulting in improved efficiency in order management, honing my skills in project coordination, system architecture, and optimization.
• Oversaw the coordination of orders comprising up to 6000 units, contributing to the production and delivery of products for renowned high street brands, refining my proficiency in time and project management.
• Owned relationships with client’s buying teams giving me a deep understanding of customer-focused business models, allowing me to work on a more collaborative and informed approach to software development and problem solving, ultimately leading to solutions that resonate more effectively with clients and their customers.

positions.title: Temp Intern/Analyst
positions.description: • Provided project-specific assistance, translating and producing pieces of analysis.

positions.title: Graphic Design Intern
positions.locationName: Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
positions.description:
• Designed and coded email templates for marketing campaigns using Dreamweaver & HTML that would engage our client’s customers by providing incentives to make reservations resulting in increased business and customer loyalty.
• Collaborated with the UX/UI team and developers to design and implement front-end elements of the platform, deepening my comprehension of the nuanced interplay between design and implementation in software development. This experience provided first hand insight into the workflow of software engineers, enriching my understanding of the collaborative processes involved in creating user-friendly interfaces.

positions.title: Cashier Student Representative
positions.description:
• Administered deposits and payments of large amounts.
• Managed database entry and digitalized cashier records.
• Assisted Rice students, faculty, and visitors with payments, registration issues, and tuition financing.

positions.title: Alternative Spring Break: Immigration and Bilingual Education
positions.description:
• Tackled social issues regarding bilingual education in low resource immigration communities.
• Mentored low income students in the Valley Area.

positions.title: Teaching Fellow
positions.description:
• Taught math to 8th grade students who attend low resource schools.
• Facilitated parent-teacher conferences in both Spanish and English.
• Created and prepared innovative and engaging lesson plans.
• Organized events that promoted student involvement and college readiness.

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
• Participated in launch team for the book STRETCH by Rice Professor Scot Sonenshein.
• Created effective ways to mobilize book sells.

company.name: Rice Business - Jones Graduate School of Business

projects.title: Doerr Institute for New Leaders
projects.description: - Worked one-on-one with leadership coach to strengthen leadership capacity, increase self-awareness and bolster personal effectiveness as a leader.

projects.title: 2hot2handle Market Web Application
projects.description:
Contributed to the coding of the app in a full stack capacity, for example:
-Coded backend components such as creating a booking feature for the product from the show page for  
customers and creating a filter for the index page using Stimulus and Javascript
-Implemented frontend components such as the customer profile page using HTML and SCSS/CSS
-Designed the UX/UI using Figma
